integrand: drivepoint.actual_tau6_Nm * drivepoint.velocity6_rad_s at SAME captured PRE stage. P_i W; W_i=left-Riemann sum(P_i*.0005) J.
sign_split: Per axis before grouping: positive=max(P_i,0), negative=min(P_i,0) signed. Group net=positive+negative; no regeneration credit.
phase: actual control row.phase.phase at index physical.sample_index//20, not hardcoded1.95 or Npush; verify physical_sample_rows and command/post stamp. Keep all observed phases, whole episode includes approach.
time_check: sample_index and drivepoint.physics_tick both equal physical index; stage matches drive time/cache_stages.drive_s and control command+subindex*.0005, rootPOST=stage+.0005; final sample included as [lastPRE,lastPOST). No q/dqPOST reconstruction.
prefix: compare shared100Hz fields at same index strictly BEFORE min(actual first timed_push index), report value count/maxdiff/JSON float bits, not2k bitidentity or a qualification gate.
events: reported old grades preserved; from physical existing air_qualified/air_run_s extract first confirmation, first subsequent total>1N landing, main mesh peak; no newgrade or score mutation.
missing: missing fields/time/schema/nonfinite -> explicit unknown/instrumentation error and saved prefix only, never manufacture0. No retry/raw reread.
